message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crimes based on facts. The facts: Husband repeatedly beats wife, on June 26 2016 he beats and insults, then the wife falls into river and drowns. Autopsy shows injuries consistent with assault, neck compression, blunt force, causing light injuries (second-degree). The death is due to drowning but injuries contributed. Likely charges: intentional homicide? But the death is caused by his assault leading to drowning. Could be "故意伤害致人死亡" which is a crime of causing death by intentional injury, which is under Chinese criminal law: Article 234 (intentional homicide) vs Article 232 (intentional injury). Actually causing death by intentional injury is punishable under Article 234 (intentional homicide) if the intent to kill is present. Here maybe no explicit intent to kill, but his assault caused death. That is "故意伤害致人死亡罪" (intentional injury resulting in death). Also "虐待家庭成员罪" (domestic violence). The prosecution mentions "故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使被害人死亡". So charges: "故意伤害致人死亡罪" and "虐待家庭成员罪". Possibly also "故意杀人罪"? But they said "故意伤害" not "故意杀人". So answer: [罪名]故意伤害致人死亡;虐待家庭成员<eoa>
